paths.note: CloudFormation templates change and are deployed from main by GitHub Actions
Lambda, host or tool code changes and is deployed from main by GitHub Actions
Contracts bundled into the Lambdas, host and invoker change and are deployed from main by GitHub Actions
The agent image changes and is rebuilt and deployed from main by GitHub Actions
The invoker image changes and is rebuilt and deployed from main by GitHub Actions

humanSteps.note: The foundation stack is deployed by a human, not by the pipeline (docs/bootstrap.md)
